sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "contact_phone" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "rule_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "spec" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("company_id", "rule_version"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wilayas" ("code" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name_fr" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "geohash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "communes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wilaya_code" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wilayas (code), "name_fr" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "geohash" TEXT NULL, "boundary" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "phone_e164" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone_alt" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "risk_flag" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "total_orders" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_delivered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_failed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_addresses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "geohash" TEXT NULL, "accuracy_m" INTEGER NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "wilaya_code" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES wilayas (code), "commune_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES communes (id), "detail" TEXT NULL, "geo_confidence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "geo_source" TEXT NULL, "confirmed_deliveries" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "label" TEXT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("owner_id", "company_id", "service_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches (id), "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "address_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customer_addresses (id), "tracking_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivery_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "window_start" TEXT NULL, "window_end" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "product_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cod_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "delivery_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "company_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "driver_commission" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "other_fees" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "collected_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "payment_rule_version" INTEGER NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_outcome" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("owner_id", "company_id", "tracking_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "delivery_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "geohash" TEXT NULL, "accuracy_m" INTEGER NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "attempt_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome_note" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("order_id", "attempt_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proof_of_delivery" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "signature_path" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "driver_note" TEXT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "origin_latitude" REAL NULL, "origin_longitude" REAL NULL, "total_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "total_duration_s" INTEGER NULL, "optimized_at" INTEGER NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "algorithm" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "route_stops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "leg_distance_m" INTEGER NULL, "leg_duration_s" INTEGER NULL, "eta" INTEGER NULL, "arrived_at" INTEGER NULL, "departed_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_locked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("route_id", "sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "matrix_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "point_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "durations" TEXT NOT NULL, "distances" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("point_hash", "provider"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_settlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES batches (id), "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "orders_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "orders_delivered" INTEGER NOT NULL, "orders_failed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "orders_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_collection" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actual_collection" INTEGER NOT NULL, "company_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "driver_gross" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expenses_allocated" INTEGER NOT NULL, "driver_net" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rule_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settlement_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settlement_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_settlements (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "remittances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, "covers_from" TEXT NULL, "covers_to" TEXT NULL, "remitted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "before" TEXT NULL, "after" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_customers_owner_phone ON customers (owner_id, phone_e164) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_addr_commune ON customer_addresses (commune_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_batches_owner_date ON batches (owner_id, service_date DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_owner_status ON orders (owner_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_batch ON orders (batch_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_tracking ON orders (owner_id, tracking_number)
CREATE INDEX idx_expenses_owner_date ON expenses (owner_id, service_date DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_settlements_owner_date ON daily_settlements (owner_id, service_date DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_remit_owner_company ON remittances (owner_id, company_id, remitted_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_pending ON outbox (created_at) WHERE synced_at IS NULL
